proposal.reason: The supplied text supports a global rod drive and a gamma/zero-reference definition. It does not use the labels network_C or pair_A, so a label-to-label match with an external pair_A table cannot be confirmed. The text gives unit/constant-amplitude driving and states that endpoints are set, but it does not report numeric maximum or minimum gamma values for the cyclic record; those reversal amplitudes are therefore unresolved from the supplied document.

review.reason: The question asks about experimental drive/measurement definitions and data availability, not a target finding or mechanism. Each proposed fact is directly supported by O001: the 72-inch rod supplies the global horizontal drive; gamma is rod displacement in cm measured to 0.1 cm; x_i=0 gives no shift at gamma=0; the text describes moving the rod from left to right; the four-hysteron system is described under unit-amplitude cyclic drive; linear bearings set constant-amplitude endpoints; endpoints are among the adjustable degrees of freedom; and pair thresholds are measured quasistatically. O001 does not use the labels network_C or pair_A, so a label-level match to an external pair_A table cannot be confirmed, and it gives no numeric max/min gamma values for the four-hysteron cyclic record. The proposal's conclusion that reversal amplitudes are unresolved is therefore supported and neutral.
